text: BBY: I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high, ACT_NOW. A volume floor is not my test: day_vol is only a partial proxy on my card and fill difficulty is NOT_SERVED (R5), so I cannot adopt day_vol 1.40 as a gate, nor reject day_vol 1.31. My test is the new high after a normal pullback (C5): D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.13, H1 HH/HL at pos_in_day_range_pct 97.2. The room should print oneil's volume test as his dissent, not write it into the one trigger. My wrong-if: a one-day reaction of one atr_14d off the day's high (my translation of C7), or no fast follow-through (C17).
